instructions: Lightly oil a 1-1/2-quart baking dish or spray with a nonstick cooking spray.
Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add onions, garlic, and bay leaf. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and discard bay leaf.
Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Spoon into prepared baking dish.
notes: If you like Indian food, you'll love the wonderful blend of textures and spices in this easy casserole. Family handwritten edits applied: garlic raised to 3-4 cloves, the 1-1/2 cups cooked brown rice struck out, water raised to 1 cup, curry powder 2 1/2 tsp. A handwritten 'potatoes' note (circled 1) appears with no amount - not added, flagged for review. Checkmark on the page suggests the family has tried it.
source: Cookbook page 150, Lean and Luscious and Meatless (photo submission, family batch)
title: Curried Chick Pea Casserole
